question: Who won the Sydney Classic 2025 title in his first tournament after coming out of retirement?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Saurav Ghosal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Indian squash legend Saurav Ghosal won the Sydney Classic 2025 title in his first tournament after returning from retirement.**
 
• He defeated Egypt’s Abdelrahman Nassar in straight games (11-2, 11-6, 11-2) in the final on February 23, 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Saurav Ghosal, 38, had retired from the PSA Tour in April 2024 but returned on January 1, 2025.**
 
• He was the second seed in the PSA Challenger event and secured his 11th PSA title.
 
• Ghosal defeated Malta’s Kijan Sultana, Korea’s Minwoo Lee, and Australia’s Rhys Dowling to reach the final.
 
• He is India’s most decorated squash player, having won multiple medals at the Asian Games and Commonwealth Games.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Saurav Ghosal’s Major Achievements**__

 __
 
• Former World No. 10 in squash.
 
• Won silver in mixed doubles at the 2018 Commonwealth Games.
 
• Secured bronze medals in singles and mixed doubles at the 2022 Commonwealth Games in Birmingham.
 
• First Indian male squash player to reach the quarterfinals of the World Squash Championship.
 
 
 
• **Other Indian Squash Highlights**__
 
 
• India’s Anahat Singh won the NSW Open 2024, marking her seventh title that year.
 
• The 2025 Squash World Cup is set to be hosted in Chennai in December.
